{'text': 'Apple 預計將於 10 月推出全新 Home 系列產品，今日透過 MacRumors 撰稿人 Aaron Perris 發現的洩露圖片，我們得以一睹即將推出的新品。', 'source': "[0] Apple is expected to launch new Home products in October, and we get our first look at what's coming thanks to leaked images discovered today by MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris."}

{'text': 'HomePod mini 新顏色在洩露圖片中曝光，第四代 Apple TV 4K 沿用現行設計', 'source': '[1] HomePod mini New Colors Revealed in Leaked Images, Apple TV 4K 4th Generation to Keep Current Design'}

{'text': 'Aaron Perris 今日發現了多項新產品的證據，預計將於 10 月推出，據 MacRumors 報道。新產品包括全新 HomePod mini、Apple TV 4K 以及 iPad mini。', 'source': '[2] Aaron Perris today uncovered evidence of several new products expected to launch in October, according to MacRumors. The new products include a new HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K, and iPad mini.'}

{'text': 'Perris 在 Apple 程式碼中發現了 HomePod mini 的五款新顏色圖片。其中三款顏色（綠色、粉紅色及藍色）看起來是全新設計，連同原有的白色及黑色。', 'source': "[3] Perris found images in Apple's code showing five new colors for the HomePod mini. Three of the colors—green, pink, and blue—look brand new, alongside the existing white and black."}

{'text': '你可以在以下帖子中看到新顏色選項：', 'source': '[4] You can see the new color options in the post below:'}

{'text': '此外，Perris 還找到了一張 Apple TV 4K（第四代）的圖片。如以下帖子所見，該產品似乎沿用與現行型號相同的外觀設計：', 'source': '[5] Additionally, Perris found an image of the Apple TV 4K, fourth generation. As seen in the post below, the device appears to have the same design as the current model:'}

{'text': '從 Apple 程式碼中未能獲取有關新產品的其他細節。但這些發現進一步支持了新產品將於 10 月發佈的計劃。', 'source': "[6] No other details about the new products were gleaned from Apple's code. However, the findings further support plans for an October launch."}

{'text': '你對 HomePod mini 的新顏色有何看法？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。', 'source': '[7] What do you think about the new colors for the HomePod mini? Let us know in the comments.'}
